def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals=[v for r in g for v in r]
    bg=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
    fill=9 if 9 in set(vals) else min(set(vals)-{bg})  # hmm
    # markers: non-bg, non-fill cells. determine fill as the other frequent color
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(vals); del c[bg]
    fill=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks={(i,j):g[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,fill)}
    mr=sorted({i for i,j in marks}); mc=sorted({j for i,j in marks})
    def hseg(i,a,b):  # horizontal segment row i between cols a..b
        if (i,a) not in marks or (i,b) not in marks: return None
        ca,cb=marks[(i,a)],marks[(i,b)]
        return ca if ca==cb else None
    def vseg(j,a,b):
        if (a,j) not in marks or (b,j) not in marks: return None
        ca,cb=marks[(a,j)],marks[(b,j)]
        return ca if ca==cb else None
    out=[]
    for r1,r2 in zip(mr,mr[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c1,c2 in zip(mc,mc[1:]):
            sides=[hseg(r1,c1,c2),hseg(r2,c1,c2),vseg(c1,r1,r2),vseg(c2,r1,r2)]
            col=sides[0] if all(s is not None and s==sides[0] for s in sides) else fill
            row.append(col)
        out.append(row)
    return out
